per_candidate.id: s2:Exploring extremophile gas production as a biomarker for early Earth atmospheres
s2:C/O Ratio Studies in the atmosphere of hot Jupiters

rationale: Papers 2210.08755 and 2405.11027 directly investigate poorly understood parameters affecting the spectral appearance of exoplanets, such as atmospheric heat redistribution and methane depletion. These studies contribute substantive new evidence on specific aspects of the question, but do not fully settle it.
